# Frozen G2 family contract

SOURCE_REWRITE / TRANSLATED. Chimp=64-bit previous-value codec; Chimp32=32-bit previous-value codec; ChimpN=64-bit indexed history with N; Chimp128 is alias N=128. Chimp128-no-index=ChimpNNoIndex(128), history search tie is first ring slot; same ChimpN decoder. ChimpN32=32-bit indexed history. N must be power of two, 1..65536 (bounded checked resource domain). Full source default and test-supported N=4,8,16,32,64,128,256,512,1024 retained; malformed nonpower N rejected since truncated log2 cannot represent ring slots. Chimp stateful add/close, fresh decode, no SIMD/thread/accelerator paths. Canonical scalar C++17, unsigned modulo bit operations, shift widths checked, IEEE binary32/64, no fast math, FMA disabled. Java21 oracle; all original core and fixed-width bitstream methods unchanged. Source ByteBuffer bitstream is MSB first; stream contains first word and canonical-NaN sentinel and one false finish bit; zero padding to byte boundary. Raw BYTE_IDENTICAL, cross decode four ways. Canonical positive quiet NaN is reserved EOF; every other raw pattern (including payload NaNs) admitted. EOF values explicitly rejected on encode. Decoder count is bounded and enforces EOF, zero pad and no trailing bytes. Source getSize excludes final false bit and byte padding; FinalBits must count both. Source fixed arrays 8000/5000/4000 bytes limit source tests; no buffer-size patch. C++ owning vectors support larger safe blocks and use explicit limits. History resets per new object; streaming append preserves history. Reset must clear all state. Finalize once writes sentinel; repeated returns identical bytes; add after finalize fails. Worst raw capacity ceil(((count+1)*(W+5+log2N)+1)/8); safe overestimate, overflow checked. Max count/call1,048,576.

FPC separate frozen contract: ../fpc-chimp/contract.md. Same family implementation, original EPL-1.0 algorithm headers retained. FPC predictor table fixed 2^16, NaNs canonicalized as source, odd padding, history retained between compress calls. No universal raw-NaN bit-lossless claim.

Lossy source domain: Point(long timestamp,float value), float epsilon; PMC supports empty, Swing requires>=2, Disjoint requires>=1, Quantized requires>=1 and positive epsilon. Explicit finite inputs, strictly increasing timestamps and finite nonnegative epsilon; arithmetic hazards at extreme timestamp/value ranges rejected by wrapper with deterministic status. Native filter returns segment objects, not serialized bytes. Semantic target compares segment boundaries, double line coefficients, float reconstructed values, quantized aMin/aMax/b. Lossy serialization is new, fully specified little-endian segment frame. No source bitstream identity claim. Dense source decompressor emits each integer timestamp in each inclusive segment, not only supplied timestamps; irregular timestamps therefore expand gaps. Quantized ignores actual timestamps and emits sample indices0..n-1; preserve this behavior explicitly. filter2 is a public disjoint alternative and will be retained as quantized.filter2.

PMC: float max/min/range and midpoint, max initialized Float.MIN_VALUE but reset at first element. Admission max-min<=epsilon (range, not 2*epsilon). Mathematical midpoint ideal error<=epsilon/2, float rounding may add ulps. Use source-equivalence contract; optional measured absolute predicate against original float values, no invented strict universal bound.

Swing: lines a=(ve-vs)/(te-ts), b=vs-a*ts; double evaluation, float +/-epsilon before promotion, double midpoint. Shared continuity uses synthesized previous float. Split emits end=previousTimestamp-1. Disjoint uses exact point vs upper/lower as split condition (without +/-epsilon); split line extrapolates midpoint to current timestamp and old end=current-1. Source numerical errors from cancellation at large timestamps possible. Neither is advertised with universal strict ABS guarantee; verify source output and report epsilon violations. Finite/strictly increasing timestamp support retained via segment API.

Quantized: b=(int)(f/epsilon)*epsilon, Java saturating float->int truncation toward zero; float division/multiplication and slope candidates, double aMin/aMax. Initial aMin=Double.MIN_VALUE (positive), aMax=Double.MAX_VALUE. Segment line endpoint float cast of (aMax+aMin)/2+b, causing catastrophic single-input slope/overflow; a singleton tail after a split inherits the preceding slope bounds because the source does not reset them. Do not silently repair: diagnostic source mode reproduces these coefficients, frame can store infinities; strict-error mode rejects a frame if decoded values nonfinite or max absolute error>epsilon. Research source variant may return failed quality and is not a strict bounded lossy codec. Source empty failures reported; safe wrappers reject where source undefined.

Independent API uses vector ownership, typed values, exceptions (invalid_argument parameters/state; runtime_error malformed; length_error resources; bad_alloc allocations). Failed operations keep state via transactional copy. No overread or mutable globals. Same object external synchronization required; objects independent. Thread-safe independent calls validated. FrameCFP1 version1 contains algorithm,N,count,epsilon,initial timestamps/segments or raw payload, checksum, reserved flags; total physical bytes counted, all decoder side information stored. Cold decode requires frame only. Raw lossy segments reconstructed with bounded total dense outputs. Invalid timestamp, count,N,code lengths, unsupported variants and all trailing/truncated inputs rejected. Canonical and source-defect predicates reported separately. No optimized paths or Benchmark adapters.

Dataset plan frozen: shared Dataset_Verify index compatible 1D float32/64, verify hashes; natural ETTh1/ETTh2/exchange_rate/national_illness all numeric columns/all rows; lossy explicit f32, timestamps sequential unit ticks; block512 avoids original fixed-array random overflow. Epsilons0.01,0.1,1.0, stream/golden edges and irregular/large timestamps separately. Original fresh Java core vs C++ raw bytes and four-way decode for lossless; segment bytes and reconstructed float bits for lossy. Differential successes do not imply error-bound success. Tests record both. Required API state/reset/finalize, malformed, fuzz, sanitizer, x86 and AArch64; no performance rankings.

PMC reconstruction uses its constant value directly, preserving negative zero; invoke SegmentDecoder/reconstruct with constant_values=true for PMC raw segments. Swing evaluates a*t+b as source. CFP1 automatically selects this from the method ID.
